publisher: Bullitt County Planning and Development (BCPAD) via county ArcGIS web map
notes: County planning office zoning classification layer (BC_ZONE_AUG_21_Export) from the official county ArcGIS web map. Polygons are parcel-level, each carrying its zoning code in Zoning; Zn_Name (zone name) is blank for most parcels so it is not mapped. INCORP_AREA names the city or unincorporated area.
